QuestInfo.name: [Adventure] Brawlosseum Week 4 Reward
QuestInfo.0:
#b#eBrawlosseum#n#k

Complete at least 10 Brawlosseum battles each week to earn ranking points, which determine your overall ranking. And your rank percentage will get you Adventure Coins!

[Top  1% - 5%]: Adventure Coin x450 + 30 for each additional 1%
[Top  6% - 10%]: Adventure Coin x350 + 20 for each additional 1%
[Top 11% - 20%]: Adventure Coin x250 + 10 for each additional 1%
[Top 21% - 40%]: Adventure Coin x150 + 5 for each additional 1%
[Top 41% - 60%]: Adventure Coin x90 + 3 for each additional 1%
[Top 61% - 80%]: Adventure Coin x50 + 2 for each additional 1%
[Top 81% - 100%]: Adventure Coin x30 + 1 for each additional 1%

#bWeek 4 Progression Period#k
TKTKTK QRQRQR- TKTKTK QRQRQR

#bWeek 4 Reward Claim Period#k
TKTKTK QRQRQR - TKTKTK QRQRQR

(If you forfeit or otherwise end in the middle of a game, the battle will not count. Can only be claimed once per Maple account.)
